items.item: The crosswalk agent's changes against H1-H10
items.how: All 505 field changes were read. They hold. H1: widening is said as what every additive weighting counting each listed item above zero ranks higher, on a finite listing; the remaining 'positive weighting' uses are the weights-within-a-ratio record's defined term or 07's Sen sentence. H2: 'no second premise' is gone, and 'ranking by widening adds no premise beside the life's own concern' is used. H3: 'argued' for the order's forming is gone, and 'not shown: in the proofs it is a hypothesis' appears with 07 §4.9's filter where an entry says how a life comes to the order. H4: 'need not count', and on the lake 'preserving the fishers' own continuation does not require preserving the bed'. H5: 'C names the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens ... it asks nothing of mixed comparisons', and 广者居上 is quoted verbatim from 06 (06:18, 567, 569, 588, 626). H6: no one-center gloss remains. H7: 'continues with' is gone. H8: 'admissions end'. H9: 'compose directly, though no single theorem states the composite'. H10: 'emerges' is kept. The new Lean-bearing sentences were checked. 'Widening is what every order increasing in admission shares' is Weighting.widens_iff_every_increasing. 'On a listing's frame, every claim counted, an order is increasing in admission exactly when it meets C' is comparison_listingFrame_iff. 'With every listed item marked, an order is self-concerned exactly when it meets C' is increasingInOwn_iff_comparison, on the listing frame. The quote check was rerun independently on the new text of every changed field. Every quoted fragment in a target's says is in its home or record (one fails only by a capital letter, 05:430's 'A ranking of it ...'). The remaining failures are source quotes in readings or pre-existing. No person is named, no review claim is made, and no verbatim, OPENING, AGENTS.md or generated file was touched. The six withdrawn-record keys were dropped with their anchors kept; 07:927's anchor exists.

items.item: Fixed (medium, F8): T8's test scope missing in 39 entries
items.how: Each T8 restatement now ends 'counting their loss is the one step we offer ... Forbids and refuted by: [a test of a renewal the readers depend on]'. Read so, the test seems to test the offer toward dependents. Every one of the 39 now adds 07 §8's sentence verbatim: 'That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on, so it could pass through their prudence alone; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.' ONE-PAGE's T8 row says the same.

items.item: Fixed (medium, E1 and H6): 08's 'Where the ethics sits' quoted without its positive half
items.how: In cx-memories-sort-by-status targets[2] and cx-memories-values-as-neutral-design targets[1], the quote stopped at 'no good and evil are set over it'. It now carries 08:92's continuation: 'right and wrong, should and better form within it, in people and AI, as every standard does'. 'Where relations close' now reads 'Where relations close, read across all steps' there. The same was done in cx-hsm-forward-criterion targets[0], cx-sty-good-existence-values-coded targets[1], cx-memories-value-words-recast targets[0] and cx-drives-dimensional-collapse account_adds; the last also gains 'one way'.

items.item: Fixed (medium, H2/H3): the old frame surviving in two readings
items.how: cx-buddhist-candrakirti-no-own-thesis said 'the two hypotheses the ranking results take, the continuation condition and C ... each is a scope or order some formations hold, formed within it'. It now says 'the hypotheses the ranking results take, the continuation condition, self-concern or C ... each represents a scope or a property of an order within the account, used as a hypothesis where a theorem takes it (07 §4)'. cx-greek-protagoras-measure's 'each is a scope or order some formations hold' was re-said the same way. The agent's search was for 'an order some formations hold' and missed both.

items.item: Fixed (medium, H10): 'emerges' read as an is-to-ought derivation
items.how: cx-modphil-jonas-ought-from-being's reading is about deriving ought from being. It ended 'His claim would enter only as a warrant for the condition and C; ... and it emerges from continuation'. That is the two-premise pair, and 'emerges' with nothing shown, offered or open. It now says: 'a warrant for a hypothesis a ranking takes, the condition, self-concern or C; ... and it emerges from continuation in a sense that derives no ought: where the condition holds, an order a life holds over its own continuation ranks every widening above on a finite listing, and that a life forms such an order is not shown (07 §4.9)'. cx-greek-anaximander-justice targets[0] and cx-modphil-marx-historical-tendency targets[0] had 'emerges' followed only by two negatives. They now add ONE-PAGE's 'seeing them is needed, and not enough; counting their loss is the one step we offer'.

items.item: Fixed (medium, F9): 'C read as widening' in the crosswalk's own readings
items.how: No theorem of 07 §7's direction takes Comparison. Direction.narrowed_not_chosen takes Priority, and the alignment-direction record now says 'no theorem here takes C'. The agent had carried 07 §7's label into 13 readings and account_adds, 7 of them new. These now read 'an order ranking by widening', 07 §7's own lead ('Given the continuation condition and an order ranking by widening'). The 20 target says that restate §7's Conditional label, and one quoting ONE-PAGE's alignment paragraph, still follow their homes (see 'left').
